```{r}
source("lib/ggplot/switchbox_theme.R")
source("lib/rates_analysis/heat_pump_rate_funcs.R")
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)

library(googlesheets4)

url_sheet <- "https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1HZOZfyuCLaAWvTndVjkhhuZe6Blcp1tcajYwcHBRN3M/edit?gid=1947524045#gid=1947524045"
googlesheets4::gs4_deauth()
tariffs_raw <- read_sheet(url_sheet, sheet = "SC1_ERB2") |>
  mutate(tariff_id = paste0(utility, "_", version)) |>
  select(-source)

# Combine some categories for convenience
tariffs_coned_delivery <- tariffs_raw |>
  # Group by tariff_name, type, and all other columns except name and value
  group_by(
    utility, version, customer_class, tariff_name, domain,
    class, type, variability, season,
    start_month, end_month, period, start_hour, end_hour, tariff_id
  ) %>%
  # Summarize to combine the values and use type as the new name
  summarize(
    name = first(type),  # Use the type as the new name
    value = sum(value),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  # Apply the name mapping
  mutate(
    name = case_when(
      name == "customer_charge" ~ "Customer Charge",
      name == "merchant_function_rate" ~ "Merchant Function Charge",
      name == "delivery_rate" ~ "Energy Delivery Rate",
      name == "adjustment_rate" ~ "Adjustment Charge",
      name == "program_rate" ~ "Program Charge",
      name == "sales_tax_rate" ~ "Sales Tax Rate",
      TRUE ~ name  # Keep original name if no mapping exists
    )
  )

# Hourly Tariffs must be assigned to the month-hour grid
# For ConEd analysis...
#  + 288 rows for R3 (24 hours x 12 months)
#  + 288 rows for R4 (24 hours x 12 months)
#  = 576 rows in the LONG table called "month_hour_tariff_energy"
hourly_tariffs_coned_delivery <- tariffs_coned_delivery |> filter(variability == "hourly")
delivery_tariff_month_hour_energy <- assign_tariffs_to_month_hour_grid(hourly_tariffs_coned_delivery)

# Expand monthly and yearly tariffs to month grid
# For ConEd analysis...
#  + 60 rows for R1: 5 rates (customer, adjustment, delivery, merchant function, sales tax) x 12 months
#  + 48 rows for R3: 4 raters (no delivery, its an hourly rate) x 12 months
#  + 48 rows for R4: 4 raters (no delivery, its an hourly rate) x 12 months
#  = 156 rows in the LONG table called "month_tariff"
monthly_yearly_tariffs <- tariffs_coned_delivery |> filter(variability %in% c("monthly", "yearly"))
delivery_tariff_month <- assign_tariffs_to_month_grid(monthly_yearly_tariffs)
head(delivery_tariff_month, n=30)


# Add to database
path_rs_db <- "data/ResStock/2022_resstock_amy2018_release_1.1/rs_ny_coned_hp_rates.db"
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb(), path_rs_db)
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "delivery_tariff_month_hour_energy", delivery_tariff_month_hour_energy, overwrite = TRUE)
DBI::dbWriteTable(con, "delivery_tariff_month", delivery_tariff_month, overwrite = TRUE)
DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

```
